name: Action-effect adapter: 128-update training evidence
body:
The original 947,712-parameter action adapter completed 128 updates with an additional paired action-effect objective on 32 updates. All 825 foundation tensors remained unchanged. The saved-artifact audit passed.

The complete experiment did not establish usable door or camera control, Genie 3 parity, or three scientific breakthroughs. No further training under this hypothesis is admitted.

This release preserves all 1,073 indexed recovered files. Public metadata documents three operational audit-path redactions across assessment and visual packages; scientific records, model tensors and images remain unchanged. Historical execution plans still bind their original report hashes. Download verification and saved-score recomputation use the public index; a new model run requires fresh preparation.

Download `fetch_artifacts.py` and `release-download.json` from this release, then run:

```sh
python3 fetch_artifacts.py --metadata release-download.json --output /absolute/fresh/training-download
```

The helper verifies every part, the combined archive, exact membership and every recovered file. External foundation weights are not included. Worldline code and adapter weights use Apache-2.0; original Atrium captures use CC0. Included notices preserve external code licenses.

[Project and current results](https://github.com/RaaghavC/open-worldline)
